text:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Acme POC stuck on identity provisioning + SAML handshake for Private VPC. Okta SCIM is creating duplicate users and SAML assertion is failing with AudienceRestriction. Need help from @alex_pse and @devon_eng :pray:

alex_pse: Which environment are they hitting right now? Hosted API key or the Dedicated/Private endpoints?

maria_sales: Dedicated pool behind Private VPC. We gave them a temporary hosted API key for quick tests, but their IdP is trying to hit the Private control plane metadata and failing.

devon_eng: Can you paste the SAML error stapled to the response? Audience/ACS mismatch is the usual culprit.

maria_sales: SAML error snippet we got from Acme:
`Status: AuthnFailure; Reason: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:status:RequestDenied; Detail: AudienceRestriction failed`

devon_eng: Yep — check the EntityID and ACS URL in their IdP. For Private deployments the ACS must be the tenant-specific URL, e.g. `https://private.redwood-inference.com/saml/consume/<tenant-id>` not the hosted one. Also verify certificate fingerprint matches the metadata we provided.

jordan_platform: On the SCIM side: Okta logs show repeated creates. Looks like externalId isn't being sent so Redwood treats each POST as a new user. SCIM snippet from Okta: 
```json
PATCH /scim/v2/Users
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{"op":"add","value": {"userName":"Jane.Doe@acme.com"}}]}
```
Response: `201 Created` twice for the same logical user — Okta is resending when it doesn't get the expected confirmation. Also noticed case mismatch: `Jane.Doe@acme.com` vs `jane.doe@acme.com`.

alex_pse: Are you mapping Okta `externalId` -> Redwood `externalId`? That prevents duplicates and is recommended for SCIM integrations.

jordan_platform: They only map `login` currently. Not using externalId. We also noticed an Okta rule that preserves case, so the tenant ends up with two records.

devon_eng: Two immediate fixes: 1) Ask Acme to map Okta `externalId` to the SCIM `externalId` attribute on create/patch. 2) Enable case-normalization on the tenant or set the SCIM matcher to canonicalize `userName`/email. I can push a small change to match case-insensitively for the tenant.

maria_sales: Acme's IdP admin says ACS is already set to the hosted ACS in their config. How do we surface the correct Private ACS metadata to them?

alex_pse: For Private deployments we provide a tenant-specific SAML metadata URL during onboarding. It's in the POC onboarding doc but I'll DM you the exact URL and metadata XML. They will need to update ACS and EntityID, and potentially upload our cert.

support_bot: FYI — POC hosted API key rotation: token `poc-hosted-xxxx` was rotated at 2024-11-02T10:05Z. Any tests hitting the old hosted token will 401.

maria_sales: Exec demo is scheduled Friday — what's realistic for turnaround if Acme makes those changes?

devon_eng: If Acme updates ACS + EntityID and maps externalId in Okta, and they flip the lowercase rule, we can validate end-to-end in ~48 hours. I'll allocate a 30-minute debugging window.

alex_pse: Pricing/ops note: Extending the Dedicated POC by 48 hours to finish identity setup is fine and we can absorb it within current POC scope. If they request extra reserved capacity beyond the POC pool we'll need to escalate to finance.

maria_sales: Ok — assigning: @devon_eng owns SAML metadata verification and cert check, @jordan_platform owns SCIM mapping doc + Okta screenshots. I'll coordinate with Acme and schedule the validation call. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jordan_platform: I'll post the short SCIM mapping steps and screenshots in this channel in a few mins.

devon_eng: I'll also schedule a 30-min slot tomorrow for the SAML handshake test.
